docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,100.00 FILED BY WORLD MOTORS AS TO DEFENDANT TUIGAMALA, FATALUPE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-26-1993 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 00
